page.content:
Flavian amphitheatre for games in the heart of the city.

How Colosseum connects

  • Location: Rome — The Colosseum stands in Rome as the Flavian amphitheatre.
  • Faction: Roman Empire — The Colosseum is an imperial monument of the Flavian city.

What is Colosseum?

The Colosseum, dedicated under Titus in 80 CE, staged beast hunts and gladiatorial munera as imperial gifts. It is the stone emblem of the city after the Republic.

Key threads lead to Rome and Roman Empire.
